purpose: Development-only decoding search for TSP, JSSP, CVRP, and MIS. This search must not overwrite the original shared-cohort comparison.

validation_cohort.relationship_to_original_comparison: The original comparison used eval[0:100]; this search uses a disjoint slice from the same 500-row task files.
validation_cohort.purpose: development validation; not a pristine confirmation cohort

tsp.retry_note: Jobs 1437797-1437807 use a writable-output launcher while keeping CLASP_PROJECT_ROOT on the source directory. They are the active TSP relaunch.

foarl_same_slice_best.note: FOARL is evaluated with the best completed CLASP-selected decoding configuration per task on the same validation slice. The FOARL checkpoints remain local development reimplementations, not official author checkpoints.

mis_stage2.purpose: Focused follow-up around the best observed MIS feasibility and gap/feasibility compromise; not a proof of global optimality.
mis_stage2.selection_rule: Primary: maximize feasible instances. Secondary: minimize mean best-feasible gap among settings tied on feasibility. Results remain validation-set tuning and require fresh held-out confirmation.
